name: Loving-Kindness (Metta) Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and take a few deep, calming breaths.
Bring to mind someone you care about, and silently repeat: "May you be happy. May you be healthy. May you be safe."
Now direct the same phrases toward yourself: "May I be happy. May I be healthy. May I be safe."
Sit for a moment feeling whatever warmth or ease arises.
Take one final deep breath before gently opening your eyes.
